customManagers.description: Helm CLI version in the CI download URL. Every job downloads the same version, so all matches move in one pull.

packageRules.description: Actions stay pinned to a commit with a version comment.
Chart values are what an install pulls and only change with a signed chart tag. Do not pin a digest into them.
Same contract by update type: no pin, digest pin, or digest bump pull against chart values.
Reviewer and worker tags are empty on purpose: the install uses v plus Chart.appVersion. A human moves them with a tested chart release.
Bundled Postgres floats on 18-alpine. Stay on the 18 line.
